name: Yone
notes: Opening: Fate Sealed is cast at t=0; its mixed-damage gust lands after the 0.75 s cast time plus the 0.3 s travel delay, once, since its minimum 80 s cooldown will not come off cooldown again inside the fight.

Basic attacks permanently alternate Steel (100% physical) and Azakana (50% AD physical + 50% AD magic, dealt as two same-swing instances); the driver toggles this every attack starting with Steel, with no timeout.

Yone's passive doubles total crit chance (capped at 100%) and multiplies bonus crit damage by 0.95, and converts crit chance in excess of 100% (after doubling) into 0.5 bonus AD per 1% excess; because the engine's own crit modelling only knows the sheet's un-doubled crit chance and un-reduced crit damage, the driver compensates the AD it feeds into each basic attack so its expected damage matches Yone's true passive, and separately applies the same expected-crit multiplier by hand to Mortal Steel's AD-scaling portion, the only ability whose damage the wiki states can critically strike.

Mortal Steel's Gathering Storm empowerment (dash + whirlwind) cannot hit the same target twice, so against a single stationary dummy it always lands exactly one hit, identical in total damage to an unempowered cast; the driver therefore does not track Gathering Storm stacks and simply casts Mortal Steel on cooldown.

Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave each have their own bonus-attack-speed-based cooldown reduction (from the numbers sheet's static formulas), applied before ability haste's normal reduction via e.basic_cd; their attack-speed-based cast time reduction is not modelled since the engine only ever applies the fixed 0.25 s cast lockout regardless of the true cast time.

Spirit Cleave's damage is taken as base + percent of the target's maximum health only (the wiki's leveling table), split evenly physical/magic; the sheet's extra flat 1x AD term on WDamage is treated as stale per the dossier's binNote and is not used.

Soul Unbound is cast as soon as it is off cooldown and held for its full 5 s Spirit Form duration before recasting, to maximize the damage it marks. The engine does not expose post-mitigation damage to the driver, so the stored mark is approximated from the expected pre-mitigation damage of Yone's basic attacks, Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave and Fate Sealed landed while Spirit Form is active, at the dossier's percent-of-damage-dealt reading (25-35% by rank); item and rune procs are not tracked, matching the ability's own text.
Mana is not modeled: every cost in the numbers sheet is 0.
